:::{#def-cv-estimate-indexed}
#### Cross-validation estimate of a named procedure

When several [fitting procedures](#def-fitting-procedure) are cross-validated
with the same [folds](#def-folds),
the **cross-validation estimate of procedure** $g$,
$\cvestof{k}{g}$,
is the [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate)
computed with [fold-out rules](#def-fold-out-rule) produced by $g$:

$$
\cvestof{k}{g} \eqdef \frac{1}{n} \sumin
\sqf{g\paren{x_i; \paren{(x_{i'}, y_{i'})}_{i' \notin \fold{\foldof{i}}}} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-cv-estimate-indexed}

:::
